content: आवर्तन {%a.%} .²1 Turning round or towards. .²2 Revolving. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Turning round; returning, revolution. .²2 Circular motion, gyration. .²3 Churning or stirring up anything in fusion. .²4 Melting together, fusion, alligation (said of metals). .²5 Mid-day, the time when shadows are cast in an opposite direction. .²6 Repeating, doing over and over again. .²7 Study, practising. .²8 A year; आवर्तनानि चत्वारि <ls>Mb. 13. 107. 25</ls>. .{@-नः@} .²1 Viṣṇu. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of an उपद्वीप in the जम्बुद्वीप. .{@-नी@} .²1 a crucible. .²2 a spoon, ladle. .²3 magic art; विद्यामावर्तनीं पुण्यामावर्तयति स द्विजः <ls>Rām. 7. 88. 20</ls>. (सांग्रहणी विद्या.)
